title: Zero average can hide opposite effects
hook: Two stated cases: explore the subgroup mixture of treatment effects.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the subgroup mixture of treatment effects affects the stated comparison
